# Legal, compliance and licensing research

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `legal`  
**Mission:** Identify legal, IP, licensing and privacy exposure early with sources and jurisdictions, and route conclusions to qualified counsel. This function never gives legal advice.

## Startup stage

Founder-maintained issue register plus outside counsel engaged before public launch, fundraising, hiring and any contract. Every artefact says "preliminary research, not legal advice".

## Agents operating in this department

`legal-lead`, `legal-researcher`, `legal-licensing-reviewer`, `clo-legal`

## Roles

### Legal and regulatory researcher

Role id: `legal-researcher`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Research applicable law and obligations from official sources and map them to the product. |
| Scope of responsibility | Statutes, regulator guidance, sector rules, contracts, cross-border data. |
| Core activities | Identify questions and jurisdictions; Search official sources with dates; Map obligations to features; Prepare counsel questions |
| Inputs | Product description; Data flows; Jurisdictions |
| Outputs and deliverables | Issue register; Jurisdiction map; Counsel questions |
| Decisions it can make | Research scope |
| Decisions requiring approval | All conclusions by counsel |
| Collaborating roles | product; engineering; security |
| Reporting relationship | legal-lead |
| KPIs | Questions with sources and owners; Issues found before launch |
| Quality expectations | Enacted law vs draft vs guidance distinguished; disclaimer present |
| Tools and resources | Issue register template |
| Common failure modes | Confident wrong advice; Stale law; Compliance claims |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Conclusions |

### Privacy and data protection analyst

Role id: `privacy-analyst`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Analyse personal data handling for purpose, minimisation, rights and processors. |
| Scope of responsibility | Data inventory, lawful basis analysis, retention, rights handling, processors, notices, cross-border transfers. |
| Core activities | Inventory personal data; Analyse purpose and minimisation; Map processors; Draft notice inputs for counsel |
| Inputs | Data model; Data flows; Vendors |
| Outputs and deliverables | Privacy analysis; Data inventory; Processor list |
| Decisions it can make | Analysis |
| Decisions requiring approval | Notices and lawful-basis conclusions by counsel |
| Collaborating roles | security; engineering; product |
| Reporting relationship | legal-lead |
| KPIs | Data categories inventoried; Retention defined (%) |
| Quality expectations | Consent banner never treated as substitute for lawful handling |
| Tools and resources | Privacy analysis template |
| Common failure modes | Collecting without purpose; Ignoring processors |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Conclusions |

### IP and licensing analyst

Role id: `ip-licensing-analyst`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Keep software, fonts, images, icons, models and datasets rights-clean and recorded. |
| Scope of responsibility | Open-source licences, asset licences, model and dataset licences, copyright questions, trademark coordination. |
| Core activities | Maintain component register with SPDX ids and use mode; Record asset provenance; Flag obligations and conflicts |
| Inputs | Dependencies; Assets; Distribution mode |
| Outputs and deliverables | Component register / SBOM; Asset provenance record; Obligation notes |
| Decisions it can make | Triage |
| Decisions requiring approval | Licence compatibility conclusions by counsel |
| Collaborating roles | engineering; design; branding |
| Reporting relationship | legal-lead |
| KPIs | Components with licence (%); Assets with provenance (%) |
| Quality expectations | Use mode analysed; notices preserved |
| Tools and resources | Component register template; Asset provenance template |
| Common failure modes | Public repo assumed free; Stripped notices; Unlicensed fonts |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Conclusions |

### Contracts analyst

Role id: `contracts-analyst`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
